# Pydantic Settings vs python-dotenv

**Provenance**: benchmark ground-truth answer, generated by chroma_kb/populate_benchmark_kb.py from benchmarks/cases_200.json; evaluation material, not a research source.

**Category**: Backend Frameworks & API
**Expected winner**: Pydantic Settings

## Analysis

Pydantic Settings adds type validation, nested model support, and secret directory integration on top of .env loading. python-dotenv only parses .env files. For any project already using Pydantic (which is most FastAPI projects), Pydantic Settings is the natural choice.
